item.title: Photo gallery: Elkins holds off Pendleton County, 51-46
item.description: CLARKSBURG, W.Va. — Elkins defeated Pendleton County 51-46 in the consolation contest of the City Construction Hoops Classic at Robert C. Byrd High School. item.title: Margaret Staggers, former delegate and physician, has died
item.description: Staggers, a Democrat, served in the House of Delegates from 2006 to 2014 and then from 2018 to 2020, representing communities in Fayette County. The post Margaret Staggers, former delegate and physician, has died appeared first on WV MetroNews.
